description: This file defines a controller class for managing project translations within an admin interface, including actions for adding, editing, assigning, unassigning, sending notification emails, and closing translation projects in a PHP web application (likely following MVC pattern).

classes.name: TranslatesSubController
classes.description: Controller class handling translation project management in admin panel, extending AbstractSubController, with methods for permission checks and various translation-related actions.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access translation features, allowing only superadmin or root roles in the specified node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles the editing of translation projects; delegates processing to 'process' method with 'edit' action.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles adding new translation projects; delegates processing to 'process' method with 'add' action.

methods.name: assignAction
methods.description: Handles assigning translation tasks to users; delegates to 'process' method with 'assign' action.

methods.name: unassignAction
methods.description: Handles unassigning translation tasks; delegates to 'process' method with 'unassign' action.

methods.name: sendAction
methods.description: Sends notification emails regarding translation projects; delegates to 'process' method with 'send' action.

methods.name: closeAction
methods.description: Completes and closes translation projects; delegates to 'process' method with 'close' action.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of translation projects, possibly with filters.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method handling logic for various translation actions such as add, edit, assign, unassign, send notifications, and close project translations. It interacts with models, updates project status, assigns users, sends emails, manages errors, and returns view data.
